title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - ShieldedLamppost
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/ShieldedLamppost. A lampost with a shield. Device kind in the Lighting Domain (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.1.4.2), broader device kind: s4envi:Lamppost (skos:broader -- NOT a formal OWL rdfs:subClassOf relationship in the ttl, so its full Lamppost-like attribute set is repeated here rather than inherited from the Lamppost model).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ShieldedLamppost'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the shielded lamppost, expressed as a GeoJSON Point.

hasLightPoint.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasLightPoint'. A relation between a lamppost and its light points (sub-property of saref:consistsOf). Links to LightPoint entities.

projectsLight.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/projectsLight'. A relation between a lamppost or a light point and the light (or lights) they might project. Links to Light entities.

usesCommunicationInterface.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationInterface'. A relation between a device and the communication interface it uses. Links to a CommunicationInterface entity.

usesCommunicationProtocol.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/usesCommunicationProtocol'. A relation between a device and the communication protocol it uses. Links to a CommunicationProtocol entity.
